body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Choose one visible enemy. Gain +1 Fortitude against it and ignore its cover bonus for your next Prowess attack until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move 1 unit without triggering the chosen enemy's movement Reactions.
Gain the Fortitude bonus against all enemies instead.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: If the chosen enemy misses you before your next turn, you may spend 1 Combo to move 1 unit and give it -1 Fortitude against your next Prowess Action until the end of your next turn.
